title: Returned-Payment Fee Basis by Size of the Returned Payment
content:
**Rule.** On a Rental Property Service Contracts contract, the fee basis of a returned-payment fee follows the size of the returned payment:

1. For a returned payment of $1000.00 or more, the fee basis is 2.5 percent of the returned payment in place of the returned-payment fee level that applies to the contract. That basis is carried unrounded until the fee is rounded to the cent once at the end.
2. For a returned payment of at least $400.00 but under $1000.00, the fee basis is that fee level plus $5.00.
3. For a smaller returned payment, the fee basis is that fee level as it stands.

The returned payment is the amount of the most recent returned payment charge billed back in the contract's billing history.

## Size bands

| Returned payment | Fee basis |
|---|---|
| $1000.00 or more | 2.5 percent of the returned payment |
| $400.00 to $999.99 | the fee level plus $5.00 |
| under $400.00 | the fee level |

## Hypothetical returned payments (fee level $25.00)

| Returned payment | Fee basis |
|---|---|
| $1250.00 | 2.5 percent: **$31.25** |
| $1000.20 | 2.5 percent: **$25.005**, carried as it stands |
| $1000.00 | 2.5 percent: **$25.00** |
| $999.99 | $25.00 plus $5.00: **$30.00** |
| $400.00 | **$30.00** |
| $399.99 | **$25.00** |
| $61.74 | **$25.00** |

The fee basis is not rounded on its own: a basis of $25.005 enters the fee unrounded, and only the finished fee is rounded to the cent.
